what: Topics whose Prerequisites panel still lacks the Basics section (PROJECT_PLAN.md, 'Prerequisites first'; owner rule 2026-10-12). The build (site/src/lib/topic-checks.ts) requires the section in every finished topic not listed here, and refuses a listed topic that already has one. A release run or the daily audit adds the section (ROUTINE.md section 1B) and removes the id. Never add a topic: new topics write the section when they are built.
listed: 2026-10-12: the 7 topics on main (4 live, 3 held) and the 9 topics that were content-final on their branches when the rule was made.
